title: Job Curses the Day of His Birth
description: After his great sufferings, Job opens his mouth and curses the day he was born. He wishes that the day would turn to darkness and that night should be blotted out. Job expresses a deep longing for death and rest alongside kings, princes, and prisoners in the grave, where all are equally free. He asks why God gives light and life to those who suffer bitterly and long for death, and concludes by saying he has no peace or rest, only turmoil.
